name: writing-bench
description: LLM writing quality benchmark with ELO scoring

scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:src && bun run typecheck:web
scripts.build:web: bun web/src/build-methodology.ts && bun build web/src/app.ts web/src/dashboard.ts web/src/run-detail.ts --outdir web --target browser --minify --splitting --format esm --entry-naming [name].js --chunk-naming chunk-[hash].js && bun build web/src/style-base.css web/src/style-methodology.css web/src/style-run-detail.css --outdir web --target browser --minify
scripts.verify:web: bun run build:web && bun run check:web-budget && bun run check:web-flight --route=all
